description: This is a Swift source file implementing the VoiceWakeRuntime actor responsible for managing the voice wake word detection pipeline, speech recognition, and related audio handling for a macOS application. It includes configuration, recognition handling, state management, and logging functionalities.

classes.name: VoiceWakeRuntime
classes.description: An actor managing the voice wake word detection and speech recognition pipeline, including audio input handling, state management, recognition callbacks, and overlay coordination.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Updates and starts the voice recognition pipeline based on the latest app state, including permission checks and configuration.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the speech recognition session with the specified configuration.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the recognition pipeline, releases resources, and dismisses overlays.

methods.name: configureSession
methods.description: Configures the speech recognizer with a specific locale.

methods.name: handleRecognition
methods.description: Processes recognition results, manages capture state, and triggers recognition events.

methods.name: maybeLogRecognition
methods.description: Logs recognition transcripts and matches for debugging purposes.

methods.name: noteAudioTap
methods.description: Logs the RMS audio level of incoming audio buffers.

methods.name: noteRecognitionCallback
methods.description: Logs empty recognition callbacks for debugging.

methods.name: scheduleTriggerOnlyPauseCheck
methods.description: Schedules a check to detect if trigger words have ceased.

methods.name: schedulePreDetectSilenceCheck
methods.description: Schedules a silence detection check before initiating recognition.

methods.name: triggerOnlyPauseCheck
methods.description: Checks if only trigger words are being detected and decides to pause.

methods.name: isTriggerOnly
methods.description: Determines if the current transcript contains only trigger words.

methods.name: preDetectSilenceCheck
methods.description: Checks for silence to decide on recognition trigger fallback.

methods.name: beginCapture
methods.description: Starts voice capture and recognition session, handling both voice wake and talk mode cases.

methods.name: monitorCapture
methods.description: Monitors ongoing capture, and triggers finalization on silence or max duration.

methods.name: finalizeCapture
methods.description: Ends voice capture, processes the transcript, updates overlays, and schedules recognition restart.

methods.name: noteAudioLevel
methods.description: Updates the adaptive noise floor and records voice activity levels.

methods.name: restartRecognizer
methods.description: Restarts the recognition engine for continuous listening.

methods.name: restartRecognizerIfIdleAndOverlayHidden
methods.description: Restarts the recognizer if idle and overlay is not visible.

methods.name: scheduleRestartRecognizer
methods.description: Schedules a delayed restart of the recognition engine.

methods.name: consumeScheduledRestart
methods.description: Clears the scheduled restart task.

methods.name: applyPushToTalkCooldown
methods.description: Sets a cooldown period preventing immediate re-trigger.

methods.name: pauseForPushToTalk
methods.description: Pauses recognition for push-to-talk functionality.

methods.name: updateHeardBeyondTrigger
methods.description: Updates state indicating speech has been detected beyond the trigger word.

methods.name: trimmedAfterTrigger
methods.description: Returns the part of the transcript after the trigger word(s).

methods.name: commandAfterTrigger
methods.description: Extracts the command text after trigger word(s), considering trigger end time if provided.

methods.name: _testTrimmedAfterTrigger
methods.description: Test helper for the trimmedAfterTrigger function (debug mode).

methods.name: _testHasContentAfterTrigger
methods.description: Test helper to check if content exists after trigger (debug mode).

methods.name: _testAttributedColor
methods.description: Test helper returning a sample attributed color (debug mode).
